nodes.label: Next.js (Project-Specific Breaking APIs)
nodes.rationale: This version has breaking changes — APIs, conventions, and file structure may differ from training data; read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code and heed deprecation notices.

nodes.label: One RAF Rule
nodes.rationale: Everything registers with getRafScheduler() — a single RAF loop owns frame timing.

nodes.label: Scroll Outside React
nodes.rationale: Use useScroll / refs / transforms; never setState on scroll.

nodes.label: GPU Props Only
nodes.rationale: Animate only translate / scale / rotate / opacity / uniforms / camera.

nodes.label: Scenes Own Animation
nodes.rationale: Pages compose; scene factories animate via timeline progress — not React state.

nodes.label: FEATURE_ROADMAP Blueprint
nodes.rationale: Living product contract — another engineer or AI agent should ship from this file alone; code follows the roadmap, not the other way around.

nodes.label: Scroll-Driven Developer Portfolio
nodes.rationale: Single-page scroll-directed experience that feels like an interactive digital world; scroll is the primary interface proving “I build software differently.”

nodes.label: Five-Act Narrative Architecture
nodes.rationale: Differentiation for 2026: scroll is a directed experience with acts, not “everything moves on scroll.”

nodes.label: Act IV — Proof
nodes.rationale: Cross-cutting content + interaction system woven into Projects and a dedicated Proof strip — metrics, architecture, GitHub, before/after.

nodes.label: Motion Has Purpose
nodes.rationale: Every tween teaches hierarchy, state, or narrative progress — decorative animation without narrative purpose is a non-goal.

nodes.label: Scroll Is Storytelling
nodes.rationale: Progress maps to acts, not just opacity fades.

nodes.label: React Never Owns Scroll Frames
nodes.rationale: RAF + refs + engines outside React; setState on scroll is banned.

nodes.label: GPU-First Animation
nodes.rationale: Animate transform, opacity, shader uniforms, camera only — never width/height/top/left/margin/padding.

nodes.label: GSAP-Only Animation Decision
nodes.rationale: One animation runtime for scroll + UI; Framer Motion and Motion One banned for scroll for bundle size and architectural clarity.

nodes.label: Performance Budget
nodes.rationale: Performance over spectacle — cut effects before cutting FPS; kill switches auto-scale quality under 45/30 FPS.

nodes.label: Phase 7 — Creative Playground
nodes.rationale: Optional side quest / deep link — not mandatory in linear scroll; proves curiosity without affecting Lighthouse on /.

nodes.label: Next.js 16 App Router
nodes.rationale: Chosen for RSC, metadata, OG, and performance.

nodes.label: Mobile Is Equal
nodes.rationale: Do not disable the experience on mobile — retarget with different timelines, not a stripped corpse.

nodes.label: Engine / Scenes / Canvas / App Layer Rules
nodes.rationale: engine/ owns RAF/scroll/timelines; scenes own factories; canvas owns WebGL; app owns composition — prevent logic leaking into pages.
